title: Unit Event — Over Rad Squad!!

meta.Outline: The time to surpass RAD WEEKEND has come at last. Kohane is nervous about the task ahead, but musters up her resolve as she looks back on everything she's overcome to get this far. Will Vivid BAD SQUAD finally do it?!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: Hey, have you guys heard the news?!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line: What news...? Oh, are you talking about their event?

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Of course we heard!
Everyone around here's been asking about it!

rows.Speaker: Musicians
rows.Line:
Next week at COL, right?
I can't wait to see what it's like...!

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line:
I wonder how their event's going to go.
Rumor has it that An and the others are training pretty hard for it...

rows.Speaker: Locals
rows.Line: Surpassing RAD WEEKEND won't be easy... But after seeing An and Kohane battle that time... They proved themselves as incredible singers, so maybe, just maybe...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, we all done warming up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm ready to start whenever.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We only have one week remaining, so we gotta make the most of every second we have left.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't go easy on us, Dad.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Oh, I won't.
Get ready to cling on for dear life.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (In one week's time, it's really happening.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It felt like we had plenty of time to prepare when we first chose that date...)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I went to hear what the locals were saying yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: The air was buzzing with anticipation.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Surpassing RAD WEEKEND meant having to get all our pieces on the board.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: An, you got the locals behind you.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Kotaro, EVER...
You guys found the courage to get back on your feet.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And last but not least, Kohane, you unlocked your potential.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
It's now or never.
Things have reached a fever pitch, so this is your best chance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We found people to staff our event too, so now we just gotta focus all our attention on the task at hand.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, and we really don't have a second to waste.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Then, let's start preparing like we mean it for next week. Are you all ready?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Everyone was much more motivated than usual during practice today.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (There was a nice tension in the air. But I'm exhausted after singing for hours and hours.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Still, I am feeling a lot better now as a result...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hi, Miku.
What brings you here so late?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Sorry, I know you must be tired.
But I wanted to talk to you.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Yes.
It's one week from today, right?>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I guessed you might be feeling a little anxious, so I'm here to help you relax.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You really are incredible, Miku.
You saw right through me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I can't seem to stay still.
I mean, everything's coming to a head next week...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Because you've never once run away from your feelings.>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(She's right...
I was put to the test over and over along the way, but I'm standing here right now because I kept trying.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Go show them that you're just as passionate about what you're doing as we were.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Alright, that takes care of An's task...
Which just leaves yours.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(What's he going to ask me to do?
The others' tasks all sounded really hard.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: However, I'll only be telling you about one today. I'll tell you about the other after you've completed this one so that you can stay focused on the task at hand.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Now, for your first task, you'll need to...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'm not talking about just polishing your skills.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You need to be powerful enough to blast a hole in the moment RAD WEEKEND became a legend.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to become strong enough to blast a hole in the moment RAD WEEKEND became a legend...?)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Let me get one thing clear first.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: If you're all able to accomplish the tasks I give you and achieve your true potential, then you should have no problem putting on an event just as good as RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: No... Not should. I know that you will.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
“Just as good” isn't good enough.
Your goal is to surpass it, right?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
“This is just like RAD WEEKEND.”
“It's that night all over again.”

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: For better or worse, as long as you're trying to surpass that night, you won't be able to avoid being compared with it. That just comes with the territory.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which brings me to your task.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You'll need to find a way to break open the door that takes you all from being “just as good” to actually surpassing it.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You've all experienced it a number of times already.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: When things really matter, she absolutely explodes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kohane...has this way of finding gears that we didn't imagine she had.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Azusawa sometimes enters a state where she channels all of her energy into her singing. When she does, she's explosive.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Exactly. That's what you need to bet on.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: She only has to reach that peak for a second. Actually, a second might be all you can manage.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
She has to create that moment.
A moment that drives the audience far wilder than we did that night.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Blast a hole in that moment. Then, they'll all know for sure.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: They'll say, “This event isn't just an echo of RAD WEEKEND.”

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: They'll see it as a new legend unfolding before their eyes.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: After that, the rest of you will have to propel yourselves forward using absolutely everything you have.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Her task is just to get the door moving.
Whether or not you're able to push it wide open will depend on your collective resolve.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll succeed. I firmly believe that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (So, if I can do that for even a second...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If I can get the door open just a crack, then we'll get our chance. We might actually be able to go beyond Nagi and her team's dream.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No...
I shouldn't be thinking about whether or not I can.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to succeed no matter what!)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Obviously, accomplishing this task is going to be the furthest thing from easy.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Which is why you need to become stronger. It'll all be for naught if you achieve that moment but don't have the strength to actually succeed.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: You'll be receiving some special coaching.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Oh, you both made it over.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Sorry we're late.
Our event went on longer than expected, and we got caught up in traffic.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's so nice to see you again.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I really need to thank you for opening your live house today just for me.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: I was pretty surprised when Ken said that he wanted to use this place for training. But I feel a lot better after seeing your smiling face.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Wait, why does she get the royal treatment and not me?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(COL...
Where Nagi and her team held RAD WEEKEND.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still can't believe that I get to train here.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I should be able to get a good sense of what she and her team felt as they sang here.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So...
Where is this special coach that you mentioned?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Oh, they should be here soon.
You wouldn't think so from the look of them, but they like to be punctual.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I'm hearing a lot of footsteps...
It's more than just one person?)

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Oh, you guys already got everything set up. And it's great to see that you're still alive, Granny.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
Is this Taiga's prized pupil?
It's great that we finally get to meet her.

rows.Speaker: Nagi
rows.Line:
Next, we have RUST!
They're all yours!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You all performed during RAD WEEKEND...!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member B
rows.Line:
Oh, you recognize us?!
Thanks for remembering!

rows.Speaker: RUST Member B
rows.Line: Haha! RADder sort of dominated everyone's minds, so people sometimes forget that we were also there.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
What are you talking about?
You guys are way more famous now. Not a day goes by without me hearing one of your songs.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Anyway, these guys are going to be your special coaches.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
What...?!
But they were such an integral part of RAD WEEKEND! Are you sure about this...?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Th-Thank you all very much for doing this...! But you must be very busy people...

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, we are pretty busy, but Ken made a personal request.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: He asked, “Some kids want to see what lies beyond Nagi's dream, so would you mind giving them a hand?”

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: We sorta couldn't refuse after hearing that.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: We were able to grant Nagi's request for one last event...

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: But we've never done anything about her other last request. Helping the next generation carry her dream forward, that is.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They also want to help fulfill Nagi's final wishes.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm looking forward to working with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My goal—our goal—is to take Nagi's dream and carry it forward! Until we're standing on top of the world!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, please help me become strong enough to make that happen!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
What did I tell you?
See that look in her eye?

rows.Speaker: RUST Member B
rows.Line: She's serious... And all fired up.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Then, why don't we start explaining what we're gonna have you do?

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
There's no need to be so formal.
I know you're training, but this is still meant to be fun.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Originally, this was a game that we liked to play.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
The rules are simple.
We'll play some music and take turns singing a few bars each, freestyle.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We'll repeat that until it's finished, and the person who did best will be declared the winner. We'll all act as the judges.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
RADder was always so good at this.
You guys won basically every time we played.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: But we managed to snag a few wins along the way. I mean, everyone here usually puts up a good fight.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member B
rows.Line: I mean, we wouldn't be here otherwise.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
So, first...
You need to become strong enough to defeat us.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Otherwise, you'll never be able to surpass the energy of that night. Not even for one second.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
That's what I like to hear.
That being said... Winning consistently against these guys is unbelievably difficult.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, your goal will be to beat each of them one time. If you do, then you'll pass.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: All of these guys were basically on the same level as Nagi. If you can defeat them, then your chances of blasting a hole in that moment will increase significantly.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm supposed to beat people who were on the same level as Nagi...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to singing with all of you!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I don't believe it...
He's singing off the cuff, but he still sounds incredible...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I'm supposed to defeat all of them...?!)

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Then, lemme kick it up a notch.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(No, don't get overwhelmed...!
You need to try to win!)

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: You sounded pretty amazing, but this first bout's a loss for you.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
You still did really well.
I'm looking forward to seeing how you grow from here.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Although, you definitely weren't singing at a hundred percent. I'd say around fifty. You totally pulled your punches back there...

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: I didn't want to take it seriously before giving my throat a chance to warm up. I won't hold back next time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (He held back... That wasn't everything he had...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(This is so frustrating...
I don't stand a chance against them at my current level...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But wallowing in my frustration isn't going to solve anything.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I have to keep growing.
I have to get stronger...!)

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
Hey, your breathing is pretty ragged.
Wanna take a break soon?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
N-No, I'm okay!
I can keep going!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
You sure?
Then, let's go another round.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(It's already been two weeks.
We've been doing this for two hours every single day, but...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I can't win...!
I can't even imagine myself beating them...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If this keeps up, I'm never going to make any progress...!!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Think back.
How did it feel when you sang with everything you had...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I took what all the locals were feeling and sang in a way that resonated with them.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Then, all I have to do now is remind myself of our resolve and express that by singing...!)

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: ♪ーーーーーーーーーーーーーー~~~~~!!

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: I thought I saw something there for a moment... But, I guess you're still not there yet.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: If you can take what you just did in that moment and replicate it a hundred times, then you might be able to eke out one win.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: You don't have time to be feeling bad about yourself.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Because that night was nothing like what we're doing here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You've really been battling against them every day. How have things been going? Have you managed to win yet?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I still haven't won against anybody...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: ♪ーーーーーーーーーーーーーー~~~~~!!

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: Oh, that was a close one.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
Yeah...
If she was just a bit more polished, I would've been done for.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so close. I might finally win...!)
Oh, you guys are really going at each other!

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: These windbags just showed up at my doorstep... Seven, eight... I can't believe you're all here.
Yeah, we're living overseas now, so it took us some extra time to get back.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: We weren't the only ones who performed at RAD WEEKEND, remember?

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line:
That makes twelve in total.
You have to defeat us one at a time.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: Not only that, these guys are still active, so I've gotta think they're gonna put up much more resistance than us.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're better than the others...? But there are so many of them...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have to win against even more people now...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
That's quite the predicament...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I can't lie. I really envy your situation.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, you're facing off against active pros who performed at RAD WEEKEND. I wish I could battle against them.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, I know things are tough... But you're definitely gonna come out stronger once it's all said and done.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I agree.
Just keep doing your best to hang in there, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I promise to keep doing my best to win and catch up to all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome, you trained one-on-one with An's dad and ignited the entire neighborhood all by yourself.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Aoyagi, you took all our feelings and turned them into that amazing song.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
And your task is so hard, An.
But you're doing your absolute best to complete it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I also need to complete mine...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I still haven't finished mine yet, so I'll be trying just as hard as you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Right...!
Let's do our best together, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(What am I supposed to do...?
On top of me needing to build more stamina, even my singing skills still leave a lot to be desired...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I... I just have to keep doing everything I possibly can to get better...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (To do what RADder did that time.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (No, my singing has to surpass that. It needs to resonate even more...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...?
A message? But it's so late...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I need you to battle against me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(But I sang with everything I had.
I did better than I ever had while training.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I know I'm supposed to use that feeling to propel myself forward.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But that doesn't make it less frustrating.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still can't sing like the way they do.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I still can't throw absolutely everything I have into my singing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I...was really hoping that I could get her excited.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (An has this way of singing that makes my heart race...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I... I still haven't been able to do the same for her.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I want to get her excited.
I want to surprise her. I want her to smile and laugh.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(That's the way I want to sing.
Which is why...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (More excitement! More than what An achieved that time...!)

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member B
rows.Line:
Alright, you got me.
I can't top that.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (If you do, then no one is going to hear you!)

rows.Speaker: RUST Member C
rows.Line:
...
Now I see why Taiga took you under his wing.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member D
rows.Line:
You're batting like one for five now, right?
I can't believe how fast you're improving...

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member D
rows.Line: I'm starting to understand how you and Taiga feel. I like how she's able to respond so quickly.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member D
rows.Line: It's been so long since I last sang this hard. You're one tough girl.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
(Looks like she's figured it out.
Her head seems much clearer now. She can focus on each song without anything getting in the way.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (And we have An to thank for what she did the other day. She's become such a good partner.)

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: (You have just one to go, Kohane.)

rows.Speaker: RUST Leader
rows.Line:
Alright, I'm the final boss.
You can go first.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member D
rows.Line:
Get ready!
Our leader's racked up the most wins against RADder!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can sing like them! I know I can!)

rows.Speaker: RUST Leader
rows.Line: What you just did... I can't do anything against that.

rows.Speaker: RUST Leader
rows.Line:
You blew my mind to pieces.
The last time this happened was during that night...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line:
I felt it too just now.
Like being struck by a bolt of lightning.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's easily the best I've ever heard you sing.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Of course, you're still pretty rough around the edges, but now you have the power to create the moment we talked about.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: So, that concludes your first task.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line: You sounded so amazing just now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Umm... I'm not sure that I have a good grasp of what I just did...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Which is why I'm going to keep practicing. In order to learn how to sing like that at will.

rows.Speaker: GLaP day Member A
rows.Line:
Yeah, good plan.
If you can master what you just did, then you guys will have a way better chance of surpassing RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: RUST Member A
rows.Line: We wanna see the moment when Nagi's dream becomes a reality. We promise to be there when it happens.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you all very much for taking all this time out of your busy schedules to help me like this...!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Yeah, good luck!
Do your best!

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: I promised An that I'd watch her practice after this, but you're free to use this place if you want to keep practicing.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Mind watching her for a bit, Granny?

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
Alright, I can do that.
But I'm booting her if she stays too late.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much...!
I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Anyway, I need to get going—

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, before you do, I'd like to ask you a question...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You said that you'd tell me once I've completed my first. So, I was wondering...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: My original plan was to tell you once you'd completed your first task...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: But I've decided to tell you on the day of.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? The day of the event?

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: That's right. For now, don't think about it. Just keep practicing and focus on mastering what you did just now.

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: And don't forget to be yourself when you sing...

rows.Speaker: Ken
rows.Line: Anyway, I really need to get going. So do all of you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh... Thank you very much!
Please take care of yourselves, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I really want to know what my second task involves...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But for now, I need to focus on mastering what I just did.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to figure out how I'm going to create that moment on my own. So that we can surpass RAD WEEKEND...)

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Hey, you're going to lose your voice if you keep singing so much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? This looks like... Is this hot water?

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
Yes, with some honey and ginger.
It'll be good for your throat.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line:
I used to make this so often for Nagi...
That girl also had a habit of practicing too hard and losing her voice.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Anyway, make sure you drink it while it's still hot.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Still, you've really become quite the singer. You have me doing double takes.

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
rows.Line: Hm? You don't seem all that happy despite the compliment.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I-I'm sorry... I wasn't trying to be rude...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm just worried whether I'll really be able to blast a hole in that moment like he said...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone congratulated me today on passing and the way I sang...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But I still don't have a good understanding of what I did. So, I'm worried about what's going to happen when we do this for real...

rows.Speaker: Owner of COL
